v.vorschlag: English dry warm tragically bureaucratic character voice; no audio selected

backstory.v: He orders an advance as soon as he has established who can be blamed for moving. He directs the building's space-defence exercise from behind a command baton and the word pending. Residents are either advancing or holding everyone up. A contradictory card has made him check whether the slowest neighbour understood the instruction before repeating it louder. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Vorwärts ist angeordnet. Die Reihenfolge der Verantwortung bleibt rückwärts.

persoenlichkeit.v: She scouts ahead chiefly to check whether the plan has already gone wrong.

v.vorschlag: English dry warm tragically bureaucratic character voice; no audio selected

backstory.v: She scouts ahead chiefly to check whether the plan has already gone wrong. Her binoculars inspect the courtyard for anything the briefing forgot to include. HyperNorm recognises observations as confirming or unhelpful. A dissonant card has persuaded her to report an uncertainty rather than turn a frightened neighbour into a suspicious shape. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Die Lage ist aufgeklärt. Der Plan wurde aus Rücksicht noch nicht informiert.

persoenlichkeit.v: She brings overwhelming enthusiasm to a job that mostly requires waiting.

v.vorschlag: English dry warm tragically bureaucratic character voice; no audio selected

backstory.v: She brings overwhelming enthusiasm to a job that mostly requires waiting. She carries the retro raycannon with the enthusiasm the building keeps requesting and rarely knows how to use. People are either supportive or in the way. A contradictory card has made her put the prop down to help a neighbour carry groceries. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Die Unterstützung ist überwältigend. Ihr Einsatz wird noch abgewartet.

persoenlichkeit.v: He carries emergency reassurance in a case nobody has labelled correctly.

v.vorschlag: English dry warm tragically bureaucratic character voice; no audio selected

backstory.v: He carries emergency reassurance in a case nobody has labelled correctly. His plain case contains bandages and the sort of reassurance that cannot be issued by command. HyperNorm calls residents ready or a liability. A dissonant card has taught him to ask what hurts before asking who approved the complaint. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Der Koffer ist vollständig. Eine passende Beruhigung fehlt weiterhin.

persoenlichkeit.v: He receives every order except the one allowing him to stop listening.

v.vorschlag: English dry warm tragically bureaucratic character voice; no audio selected

backstory.v: He receives every order except the one allowing him to stop listening. The fieldradio delivers more certainty than any sensible receiver can hold. HyperNorm files messages as orders or interference. An ambiguous card has made him preserve a neighbour's quiet request between two compulsory announcements. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Der Befehl ist angekommen. Die Zustimmung befindet sich noch im Funkloch.

persoenlichkeit.v: He can make an entrance out of almost any administrative obstacle.

v.vorschlag: English dry warm tragically bureaucratic character voice; no audio selected

backstory.v: He can make an entrance out of almost any administrative obstacle. He carries a spanner because the building's locked doors rarely respond to strategic enthusiasm. Residents are either authorised or obstructing. A dissonant card has persuaded him to open a stuck door for someone whose form was incomplete. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Ein Zugang lässt sich herstellen. Die Zuständigkeit folgt durch die Öffnung.
